b5ce26cf-96f9-430b-bb6c-a365127e9965.data: Mitosis is a process where a single cell divides into two identical daughter cells through cell division.
b5ce26cf-96f9-430b-bb6c-a365127e9965.text_lemmatized: Mitosis is a process where a single cell divides into two identical daughter cells through cell division.

e76ad085-4e63-4b3a-be74-9b5901ee573b.data: Mitosis has five phases: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, and Telophase.
e76ad085-4e63-4b3a-be74-9b5901ee573b.text_lemmatized: Mitosis has five phases: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, and Telophase.

a4fade44-1822-4d15-9653-67df58343a0a.data: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.
a4fade44-1822-4d15-9653-67df58343a0a.text_lemmatized: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.

110b32cb-c35f-475f-b26d-f3a25397d359.data: In Prophase, chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, and the membrane around the nucleus dissolves away releasing the chromosomes.
110b32cb-c35f-475f-b26d-f3a25397d359.text_lemmatized: In Prophase, chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, and the membrane around the nucleus dissolves away releasing the chromosomes.

26cd9a9a-cd81-40ad-962b-c5fe23af3551.data: During Metaphase, the chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center of the cell, and the mitotic spindle fibers attach to each of the sister chromatids.
26cd9a9a-cd81-40ad-962b-c5fe23af3551.text_lemmatized: During Metaphase, the chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center of the cell, and the mitotic spindle fibers attach to each of the sister chromatids.

dbf40cf8-1989-4e4e-859e-88d51932734e.data: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, which pulls one chromatid to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.
dbf40cf8-1989-4e4e-859e-88d51932734e.text_lemmatized: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, which pulls one chromatid to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.

7bdfd5f8-8a4d-4e3e-a5f0-c27edf4a2edd.data: In Telophase, a full set of chromosomes gather together at each pole of the cell, and a membrane forms around each set of chromosomes to create two new nuclei.
7bdfd5f8-8a4d-4e3e-a5f0-c27edf4a2edd.text_lemmatized: In Telophase, a full set of chromosomes gather together at each pole of the cell, and a membrane forms around each set of chromosomes to create two new nuclei.
